Subject: Exec workshop — arrival windows & virtual bridge

Hi Marcus / Priya,

Thanks again for coordinating the May 24 onsite. Two quick asks as we finalize travel:

1) Can you confirm recommended arrival windows for our 3 execs (CEO, CTO, Head of Product)? Prefer earliest possible check-in but we also want a short buffer before the 9:00 workshop start.
2) What does your virtual bridge/fallback look like if venue bandwidth degrades? We have a remote COE joining from Dublin and Tokyo; latency and audio quality are priorities.

Also attaching the attendee list and a rough rooming plan (will send formally after flights).

Appreciate a short note with logistical fallbacks and any visa or arrival-letter support you can provide.

Best,
Sofia

Sofia — thanks, and great questions. Short summary below; full ops notes attached (Agenda_v2 + floorplan).

Proposed arrival windows (we'll staff an onsite escort for each):
- Executive A (CEO): 06:30–08:30 local — direct to secured arrival lounge; pickup window 06:45–07:15
- Executive B (CTO): 08:00–10:00 local — expedited meet-and-greet; pickup 08:30
- Executive C (Head Product): 07:30–09:30 local — will route through venue security for badges

Virtual bridge / bandwidth fallback:
- Primary: Venue-provided dedicated wired link (100/100 Mbps) with QoS reserved for conference A/V.
- Secondary (hot-swap): Two 5G cellular hotspots (Telco-A and Telco-B) bonded at the router level — automatic failover if packet loss > 2%.
- Tertiary: Local APAC colocation relay (we'll stream HQ -> Redwood SG edge -> venue) to reduce international hops for Dublin/Tokyo participants.

Local facilitator and backups:
- Primary on-site facilitator: Amit Shah (Redwood local ops) — handles badges, AV liaison, on-call for transport.
- Backup escalation: Priya N. (handles visas, guest passes) and Ben Carter (on-call for any executive-level escalations).

Quick asks from your side:
- Final flight ETAs + passport name spellings for expedited passes
- Any dietary restrictions for the private 18:30 working dinner on May 23

I'm attaching: ArborTech_Workshop_Agenda_v2.pdf and Venue_Level-2_Floorplan.png — see the small note on loading times and the AV closet location.

If that looks good I'll lock the secondary room and confirm SIM kits with Amit.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference

I'll also open a short Slack channel for real-time ops during the event (redwood-arbortech-may24). If anything changes to flight ETAs please flag immediately.
